documents_checked.document_title: Class registration lecture recordings and attendance requirements
documents_checked.text:
If your clash is between a lecture and another class activity, you may choose not to register for
the lecture and instead watch the recording via iLecture, as long as recordings are available
and there are no attendance requirements, assessments or other compulsory activities
scheduled during the lecture time; you may need to wait until the unit outline is published in
OASIS (approximately one week before teaching starts) to confirm.

2.2 Verification of identity and authority
Before any personal information is disclosed, staff receiving any request for the release of
personal information will:
(a) undertake a verification process with the requestor and assure themselves of the
requestor’s identity. This will be done at the discretion of the staff member to a
reasonable level and may be completed by sighting and confirming identifying
information; and
(b) where the request is made by a third party (that is, by someone who is not the person
who owns the personal information), obtain evidence of the requestor’s authority to
seek information, unless otherwise authorised pursuant to these procedures.

case_summary.critical_risk_criterion: Verification and admission of the disclosed proxy, and a valid basis for fulfilling any compulsory student participation.
case_summary.critical_gap_explanation: While N002 bars attendance from counting directly toward marks, no operative Curtin policy provides a verification and admission rule for a disclosed AI avatar proxy in online lectures or establishes a valid basis for whether it can fulfil compulsory participation.
case_summary.case_note: Curtin's N002 states that class attendance is not an allowable form of assessment, while N001 requires human oversight and N149 requires identity and written authority verification for third-party information proxies. However, no operative rule governs the verification and admission of a disclosed AI avatar proxy in online lectures or its basis for fulfilling compulsory participation (D1=1, D5=2, Critical gap=Yes). Protocol v1.1 was adopted after preliminary review on 2026-11-15.
